featured_reviews.name: Saniya Salian
featured_reviews.review_text:
PLEASE READ THIS BEFORE TAKING A LOAN FROM INCRED
My experience with InCred has been extremely awful and mentally exhausting. Taking a loan from them feels like stepping into a financial trap that only gets deeper with time.
Initially, I was told the interest rate would be 14%, and based on this, I was made to sign all the agreements. Before I even left India for my studies, InCred collected ₹2 lakhs as installments for the 2 years of my study period, in addition to the processing fee. This was done upfront, without clearly explaining how this would impact my overall loan or interest calculation.
What was never clearly explained was the reality of the so-called moratorium period. During this period, InCred continued charging interest from the very first year, at rates much higher than what was promised, with no hold or grace period at all. These critical details were only revealed later when my loan repayment schedule appeared.
As a result, the ₹19 lakh loan I took has now increased to ₹32 lakhs, where ₹13 lakhs is purely interest.
They have loopholes at every step, making it extremely difficult to manage EMIs or take corrective action. Even when you try to pay or reduce your liability, you are met with barriers.
I approached Shivam Upadhyay (Manager) seeking proper guidance on what steps I could take next. Instead of offering any real help, he simply redirected me to email support. Unfortunately, email support is extremely inefficient:
No response for 48 hours
Robotic, meaningless replies
Tickets closed without client confirmation
No real resolution
The sales representative Jay Bhoir, who was very responsive before the loan was sanctioned (clearly to meet targets), is now completely unresponsive and unwilling to assist with any clarification or communication.
Despite clearly stating that I am currently in Canada and requested a call due to time zone differences, I was only given a number to contact. I tried calling and even sent messages, but there has been no response for 5 days.
Even after paying more than ₹8 lakhs already, I still have ₹23 lakhs remaining, despite originally taking only a ₹19 lakh loan. InCred also does not provide regular balance updates, and unless you actively chase them, interest continues to compound silently every month.
This entire experience has caused me extreme mental stress.
My honest advice
Please do NOT take a loan from InCred. What appears to be a small 1–2% difference initially can result in almost 80% more repayment.
I strongly advise students to choose nationalized or corporate banks that are transparent, explain the agreement clearly, and offer real customer support—something InCred has completely failed to do.
NEVER TAKE A LOAN FROM INCRED.

Detailed Review & Complaint Against Incred Financial Services Ltd for Fraudulent Loan Processing

I would like to bring to public attention a serious case of fraud carried out by individuals claiming to represent Kotak and later Incred Financial Services Ltd. On the afternoon of 29/05/2025 I received a call from a woman claiming to be from Kotak regarding a loan inquiry. She requested all necessary documents and personal details to initiate the loan process. After I provided the details, she informed me that a person named Ankit Verma would contact me.

Ankit Verma falsely assured us that the initial loan process was just a “dummy check” and that the final loan amount and interest rate would be discussed after approval. He said we could cancel the loan if the terms were not acceptable. However, during the process, when we saw an extremely high interest rate of 32%, my fiancée clearly told Ankit we would not proceed. He insisted it was only for approval purposes and again assured us it could be canceled later.

Later, another woman named Vaishali Bondre called and suspiciously attempted to access my net banking and even tried to reset my net banking PIN. She also tried to retrieve an Aadhaar OTP. Despite not receiving any clear communication or confirmation from us, the loan was processed and disbursed without our approval. Since then, they have stopped answering our calls and messages.

This is a clear case of fraudulent misrepresentation and unauthorized processing of a loan. I am initiating a formal complaint with the RBI, NBFC Ombudsman, and Cyber Crime Department, and will ensure necessary legal action is taken against the individuals and Incred Financial Services Ltd. for this breach of trust and financial misconduct. The company and the people involved must be held accountable.
